chore: adaptations for nightly-2026-06-19 nightly#251

Please review this PR. At the next toolchain release this diff will land in 'master'.

LGTM except that I don't understand the change in the file scripts/bench/open-mathlib/run:

-lake lean Mathlib.lean
+lake lean Mathlib.lean -- --setup=.lake/build/ir/Mathlib.setup.json

Right, this is from commit "actual Mathlib open" i.e. it matches more closely what import Mathlib does in the server/as part of a build.

As these benchmarks primarily exist for aiding Lean development, not Mathlib's, I surmised that evolving them on nightly-testing would make more sense, thought going through master and thus separate reviews would not be problematic either
